description: Install required dependencies and add green theme constants. Installs @react-native-async-storage/async-storage for task persistence. Extends src/constants/theme.ts with GreenTheme color palette (primary #4CAF50, dark #2E7D32, light #81C784, gradients, etc.) without removing existing Colors export.
steps: Run `npx expo install @react-native-async-storage/async-storage` to install AsyncStorage

Open src/constants/theme.ts and add the GreenTheme export with all green color constants (primary, dark, medium, light, pale, accent, text, gradientStart, gradientEnd) after the existing Colors and ThemeColor exports
acceptance_criteria: GreenTheme is exported from src/constants/theme.ts with all required green color values
Existing Colors export and theme system remain unchanged
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to confirm TypeScript compiles without errors
Import GreenTheme in a test file to verify it exports correctly
findings: All acceptance criteria met. AsyncStorage v2.2.0 installed successfully. GreenTheme exported with complete color palette. TypeScript compilation passed without errors.
